# stackfall board fixture v1
# Three settled cells under the spawn area of a T piece. Under the
# immediate-spawn rule of task T029 the forced T spawns grounded in visible
# rows 0 and 1, so reaching the lock-out rule takes the SRS (-1, -1)
# candidate of the 0->R rotation: the session rotates once, the kick lifts
# the piece so one cell stands in hidden row -1, and the hard drop that
# follows commits that hidden cell. The lock-out game over of specification
# section 4.5, unchanged by the spawn rule. The rows below run from the
# hidden row y=-2 down to y=19, so the settled cells sit at y=2.
name: lockout-ready
description: cells at y=2 under columns 3..5 ground the spawn T; rotation lifts a cell into row -1
provenance: hand-built for T023 to reach the lock-out rule in one rotation and hard drop; rebuilt for the immediate spawn of T029; independent of any piece sequence
# 22 rows from the hidden row y=-2 down to y=19; '.' is empty and a
# letter I,O,T,S,Z,J,L settles that cell in its piece color.
